decisions.reason: As a recent but somewhat niche extension that is only lightly featured, it is still worth keeping as a low-cost option on uncertain demand, though its fit with the firm's more automated growth direction is less clear than the printer lines.

This printer is close to the core offer, visibly supported on its own page, and well aligned with growing demand for integrated coding and traceability, so the option value of staying in the market remains high.

Although this close-to-core printer likely serves a more specialized and somewhat less certain niche than thermal inkjet, the firm is growing and R&D-intensive, so it is rational to keep the product while market feedback is still developing.
